Question Choices: A box plot shows a vertical line inside the box at 28. What does this line represent?
Hints: The middle value of the data
Solution: The line inside the box is the median

Question Choices: Select. A box plot has Q1 = 25 and Q3 = 32. What percentage does the box represent, from 25 and 32? ~~7% | 25% | 50% | 100%~~
Hints: Q1 to Q3 spans two of the four quartile portions.
Solution: The box extends from Q1 to Q3 and represents the middle half, or50%, of the distribution. This describes the quartile portion; ties at the boundaries can change the exact number of observations in a closed interval.

Question Choices: A box plot shows: Min = 4, Q1 = 8, Median = 12, Q3 = 18, Max = 35. Which is TRUE?   (A) 100% of data is below 18   (B) The box from 8 to 18 represents the middle 50%   (C) All data is below 12   (D) Median = average of all values
Hints: Check the box edges and distinguish median from arithmetic mean.
Solution: B:Q1=8 andQ3=18 are the box edges, representing the middle half. The stated maximum is aboveQ3, disproving A and C. A median is the ordered middle, not generally the arithmetic mean, so D is false.

Question Choices: Select. A box plot shows all values within the whiskers and no separate dots. Is an outlier shown? ~~Yes | No~~
Hints: Look for separate points beyond the whisker endpoints.
Solution: No outlier is shown. The displayed points at the whisker endpoints mark endpoints, not separate outliers. Outliers in a modified box plot are drawn beyond the whiskers.

Question Choices: A box plot shows min = 10, Q1 = 15, median = 20, Q3 = 25, max = 30. What is the range and the IQR? Range: ___. IQR: ___.
Hints: Use whiskers for full range and box edges for IQR.
Solution: Range=30−10=20. IQR=25−15=10. Report20,10, keeping the requested order.
